Implementation notes:

- The producer fails loudly (no skip) when Docker is unreachable — it is a CI
  script, not a pytest suite; SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS semantics apply to the
  suite, the script itself never silently no-ops.
- `renderer_revision` for the fixture release = the checkout's HEAD sha (the
  renderer's real code identity), passed explicitly.
- The web job keeps its existing fixture-mode legs untouched and ordered
  first; the export leg runs last so `web/dist` ends export-shaped.
- `manifest.json`/`web/releases.json`/`web/research_dossiers.json` absences
  are the honest-empty paths P34.34a/data.ts define; the seeded export emits
  everything required (incl. `web/leverage.json` per P34.34a and
  `web/tiles/*-sites.pmtiles` via the pure-Python tile renderer).

## Self-review (Phase 3)

Mechanical:

- `export_mode_leg.sh` — `bash -n` clean; `verify-fail-loud` and
  `mount-record` exercised locally (empty-dir build fails with the data.ts
  marker; missing release tree gives the named error, not a set -e abort).
  `produce`/`build`/`budgets`/`lighthouse` are Docker- or real-export-gated —
  exercised in CI only, recorded honestly.
- Producer (`build_from_spine_fixture_export.py`): names verified against
  `tests/db/conftest.py` (`_docker_reachable`, `pg_container`,
  `create_plan_database`, `run_sqitch`, `PG_*`), the seed module
  (`seed_export_spine`), `exports.spine_export` (`run_spine_export`,
  `digest_web_artifacts`, `SpineExport.write_to`, `.summary()`) and
  `exports.release` (`build_release`→`ReleaseBuild.report`,
  `validate_release`→`ValidationReport.state/.failures`). The Docker-absent
  path was run for real: exit 2 with the named reason.
- Fixed in review: (a) ci-local parity — the leg's commands are now reachable
  from `make ci-local` via `check-export-mode` (`export_mode_leg.sh`
  subcommands are the single source both sides dispatch);
  (b) `verify-fail-loud` grep — the fail-loud marker is `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export
  but`, not "export manifest" (the missing-artifact error names the artifact
  kind); (c) leg ordering — the doomed-build negative runs BEFORE the real
  build so a half-written `dist/` can never be measured;
  (d) `verify-fail-loud` resets the empty dir (`rm -rf`) so a reused local
  WORK dir can't smuggle artifacts; (e) the release test asserted
  `releases/index.html`, which is the activate overlay's output, not
  `build_release`'s — corrected to `integrity_manifest.json` with a note;
  (f) `web/.lighthouseci-export/` gitignored (the export rc writes there).

Design:

- The producer is the same code path the suite proves (`seed_export_spine`
  factored module-level, not re-authored) and the same machinery production
  runs (`run_spine_export` + `write_to` + `build_release` +
  `validate_release`) — the bytes the CI leg measures are the bytes the
  export pipeline emits, satisfying C4 NEW-26 by construction rather than by
  inspection.
- The archive-record URL is a *measurement alias*: the committed collect URL
  serves the release-builder's own record bytes at `r/_fixture-record/`
  because publication/entity ids are content-derived per run. The alias is
  honest about what it is (recorded in the rc comment + ledger).
- `assertMatrix` mirrored verbatim + a drift test — an export-only budget
  relaxation is impossible without a visible diff.
